en.title: Accessibility Panel Votes on Annual Report Including Housing Guide and Ableism Education
en.summary: The accessibility panel will vote on its annual report, which includes a housing guide and education on ableism. Developers received guidance on building accessible apps with WPF and modern web frameworks, a wheelchair user's CCTV footage sparked debate on digital disability advocacy, and Queensland announced support for next‑generation Paralympians ahead of Brisbane 2032. Salina will host its third annual accessibility seminar to promote disability inclusion.

zh-TW.title: 無障礙小組將投票通過年度報告，內容涵蓋住房指南與能力主義教育
zh-TW.summary: 無障礙小組將投票通過年度報告，內容涵蓋住房指南與能力主義教育。開發者獲得使用 WPF 與現代網頁框架構建無障礙應用的指南，輪椅使用者的未經編輯閉路電視畫面引發數位殘障倡議辯論，昆士蘭政府宣布支持 Brisbane 2032 Paralympic 下一代殘障運動員。薩利納市將舉辦第三屆年度無障礙研討會，以推動殘障人士包容。
